title: As Long As It Takes
logline: On a long, silent meditation retreat in the hills, a teacher meets each student for a few minutes every evening, trying to gauge, without ever quite asking, how deep they've gone.

object.note: Object 8 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: Presence at the end of lives turns inward: a teacher's brief evening meetings on a silent retreat, trying to gauge how deep each student has gone.

thread_out.thread: From measuring stillness to keeping death close: a forest monk who sits at a village cemetery every morning before the village wakes.

requirements: A residential meditation centre willing to allow filming without disrupting the retreat
Students willing to be filmed and interviewed with full consent

suggestions.name: A forest meditation centre in the Kandy or Matale district hills
suggestions.why: The hill country has a number of established meditation centres of the kind this story needs.
